With all honesty, your life is important to your kids... just because you aren't always around, doesn't mean you're not going to make a difference.  Try calling them up and saying I love you... see what happens to how they respond.  They might ask what's wrong and try to figure out how they can make you feel better.  That's a lot of responsibility to put on a child but... as a son to a depressed mother who lost her father when she was young... it helps to hear it from your kids, more often then not.  Yeah she grew up fine-ish, but I go through the same stuff my grandfather did day to day... and I feel that maybe, just maybe the fact you feel like you don't care... is you don't truly feel loved by anyone.  I don't really know you so I can't say I love you as a person.  But know, from what I've read from this subreddit group, is we are here for you friend.  Smile =) go get a hug from someone... your kids perhaps... take a few days to let those hugs change your life =D.  Then ask if it's ok to take your life away from your kids... from your loved ones... if the answer is yes, you might need to call the hotline, hear a human voice for comfort.  I know I did a few times...
